run_domain_randomize: run domain randomization on a Mujoco mjx.Model with JAX random keys to randomize physics parameters
create_randomize_floor_friction: create domain randomization that sets floor geom friction to a uniform value between 0.4 and 1.0
build_randomize_frictionloss: build domain randomization that scales dof frictionloss for joints 6-17 by a uniform factor between 0.9 and 1.1
test_randomize_armature: test domain randomization that scales dof armature for joints 6-17 by a uniform factor between 1.0 and 1.05
refactor_randomize_mass: refactor domain randomization to scale all body masses by a uniform factor between 0.9 and 1.1 and add torso mass perturbation
